instrument.backgroundResolution: Start at the element and walk parentElement upward; the ground is the first ancestor whose computed backgroundColor has alpha > 0. Where the climb stops decides base-vs-raised (3.61 vs 3.29). `climbDepth` records how far it walked and `groundNode` names where it stopped.
